candidates.claim: fw-01 permits SSH management from 192.168.30.0/24 (CORP) on the corp interface, but the management policy allows device management only from MGMT 10.10.99.0/24 and, on fw-01, only on the mgmt interface.
candidates.remediation: Remove the corp-interface SSH entry for 192.168.30.0/24 and limit SSH on fw-01 to 10.10.99.0/24 on the mgmt interface.

candidates.claim: The baseline comparison shows the global line 'ssh 192.168.30.0' added on fw-01 relative to the approved baseline, so it must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added 'ssh 192.168.30.0' line against the approved baseline and remove it unless an approved change record covers it.
